title: Pure Iron Chain
summary: Pure Iron Chain deck-destruction, burn, and EARTH Synchro control build, featuring Warden Armstrong's brutal prison enforcement cards. The deck uses Iron Chain Repairman to repeatedly revive Tuner Iron Chain Coil with unnegated effects, tuning into Iron Chain Dragon to mill the opponent's Deck while Poison Chain and Paralyzing Chain convert milled cards into devastating burn damage.

summary.title: Starters
points: Iron Chain Repairman (Level 4 Warrior) Special Summons any Level 4 or lower Iron Chain monster (such as Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil) directly from your GY once per turn.
Crane Crane Normal Summons to revive Level 3 Tuner Iron Chain Coil or Iron Chain Snake from your GY, enabling an immediate Level 6 Synchro or Rank 3 Xyz Summon.
Psychic Wheeleder and Psychic Tracker Special Summon themselves from hand while you control a Level 3 monster, providing instant Tuner or non-Tuner extension.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Iron Chain Repairman, while Foolish Burial dumps Iron Chain Coil from Deck to seed Repairman's revive.

summary.title: Opening: Iron Chain Repairman
steps: Send Iron Chain Coil to the GY via Foolish Burial, discard, or as Link material.
Normal Summon Iron Chain Repairman and activate its ignition effect to Special Summon Iron Chain Coil from your GY.
Activate Coil's effect on the field to give Repairman a permanent 300 ATK/DEF boost.
Special Summon Psychic Wheeleder or Psychic Tracker from your hand while controlling Level 3 Coil.
Tune Level 3 Tuner Coil with Level 3 Tracker for Level 6 Iron Chain Dragon, or with Level 4 Repairman for Level 7 plays.
Attack with Iron Chain Dragon to mill 3 cards from the opponent's Deck, triggering Paralyzing Chain to burn.

summary.title: Deck Destruction & Burn Engine
points: Iron Chain Dragon mills the top 3 cards of the opponent's Deck every time it inflicts battle damage, and banishes Iron Chain monsters from your GY to gain 200 ATK for each.
Iron Chain Snake equips itself to an opponent's monster to reduce its ATK/DEF by 800, and mills cards from their Deck equal to that monster's Level when it is destroyed in battle.
Poison Chain forces the opponent to mill cards from the top of their Deck during each of your End Phases equal to the number of face-up Iron Chain monsters you control if you did not attack.
Paralyzing Chain inflicts 300 burn damage to the opponent every single time cards are sent from their Deck to the GY by a card effect.

summary.title: Bosses & Spell/Trap Denial
points: Naturia Barkion is made using Level 3 Tuner Coil and a Level 3 non-Tuner, banishing 2 cards from your GY to negate and destroy Trap Cards.
Goyo Guardian steals opponent monsters destroyed by battle, while Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier discards to bounce problem cards.
The Phantom Knights of Break Sword detaches a material to pop a card on each field.
